title: Count tool input and real output tokens in the Claude screen's working line
notes:
The Claude screen's working line ("↓ N tokens") reads far lower than Claude Code's for the same turn. It counts only streamed text_delta and thinking_delta characters / 4 (STREAMED_DELTAS in src/shared/chat/chat-transcript.ts) and skips tool input (input_json_delta), so a turn that writes a large file or a long command barely counts.
- Count input_json_delta characters too, while streaming.
- When the message's usage arrives (message_delta / the assistant message's usage.output_tokens), switch the count to the real output tokens for that message; sum across the turn's messages.
- Check against Claude Code on the same prompt and put both numbers in the PR. Tests in chat-transcript.test.ts.

Shipped in #212: the working line counts input_json_delta while a message streams and takes each message's cumulative message_delta usage.output_tokens, summed over the turn. A Write turn read 1 token before, 735 after, matching Claude Code's 735. Not done: a subagent's output tokens are still left out.
